name: Stand-Up India
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
target_group: Women entrepreneurs and eligible SC/ST entrepreneurs
eligibility: Applicant must meet the current Stand-Up India eligibility conditions and bank appraisal requirements.
benefits: Bank loans for eligible greenfield enterprises, subject to scheme and lending conditions.
application_process: Approach a scheduled commercial bank or use the official Stand-Up India channel for application and guidance.
source: Department of Financial Services / Government of India
